name: Sex Teacher Tsuyoshi ~Junjou Otome ga Nurashichau Himitsu no Seikan Jugyou~

Thus, using his experience and techniques as a sensual massage therapist, he begins his tantalizing, indecent, and busy days teaching innocent girls the joys of being a woman.
